tools.description: Resolve a company, compare supported claims with current company evidence, preserve a proof record, and optionally monitor verified claims for change. This call consumes normal CompanyProof claim credits and writes to the account evidence ledger.

answer.description: Natural-language answer from which CompanyProof should extract supported claims.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction code, for example GB.

name.description: Legal or trading name used to resolve the company.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for safely retrying the same verification.

monitor.description: Keep verified claims connected to change monitoring. Requires an eligible live key.

claims.description: Structured company claims. Use this instead of answer.

field.description: Company field to compare with current evidence.

published.description: Value the calling system plans to publish or has already published.

tools.description: Find ranked CompanyProof company matches by name, registration number, VAT/tax identifier or ticker, optionally narrowed by subdivision and city/state.
